First public release of SlideMate: study lecture slides with an AI tutor that has read the whole deck.

### Highlights
- **Whole-deck tutor**: right-click any slide → *Explain this slide*. Answers connect to the rest of the lecture.
  Runs on your own **Claude** or **ChatGPT** account (Claude Code / Codex CLI), so no API keys.
- **Send to iPad**: one click AirDrops a slide, or a snipped part of one, to your iPad for annotating in GoodNotes
  or Notability.
- **Lecture notes**: record a lecture (on-device transcription with NVIDIA Parakeet) or import a transcript. You
  get a summary plus notes for each slide, with the lecturer's exact words and audio playback.
- **Organised library** of your course folders, with chats saved per slide, archive, rename and an auto-filing
  inbox.
- **MCP connections**: plug in tools like a Blackboard or Canvas MCP. The tutor can check your deadlines, and a
  **Pull** button syncs new slides.
- Model and effort picker, plus a context and plan-usage meter.

### Install
1. Download **SlideMate-0.1.0-macOS.zip** below, unzip it, and drag SlideMate into Applications. It's a universal
   app for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13+.
2. First open: macOS 15+: System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**. macOS 13–14: right-click →
   **Open**. The app isn't notarised yet.
3. Make sure Claude Code (`claude auth login`) or Codex (`codex login`) is installed and signed in. The setup
   screen walks you through the rest.

Prefer building from source? `git clone https://github.com/Mattlo0546/slidemate && cd slidemate && scripts/install.sh`
